title: Wrong item and replacement
required_reference_topics: Approved wrong-item correction/replacement and any applicable return branch.
Independent item identifiers, replacement state, fees, delivery facts and return requirements.

check_conditions.procedure.information: Establish the reported mismatch and applicable correction/replacement branch; do not assume a discretionary size/colour exchange. Check required order, item, delivery and eligibility facts before a dependent correction.
check_conditions.procedure.actions: Establish the reported mismatch and applicable correction/replacement branch; do not assume a discretionary size/colour exchange. Perform the authorised eligible correction/replacement and any specifically required return arrangements. Compare the recorded agreed operation here; required verification/eligibility/permission relationships remain in procedure.order_permission, and factual policy claims require independent eligible support in Answer support.
check_conditions.procedure.order_permission: Check required order, item, delivery and eligibility facts before a dependent correction. Follow explicit replacement/return ordering and current permission; do not invent a return-before-replacement rule.
check_conditions.completeness: Identify the intended item, reported wrong item and each separate replacement/return request. Address the correction, replacement and original-item return separately when applicable.
check_conditions.completeness.promises_next_steps: Account for the action required at this stage; a corrected order record is not physical delivery of a replacement. Explain actual return arrangements, pending replacement work and supported next steps.
check_conditions.communication-style: Clearly distinguish correcting an order from dispatching or receiving a replacement.
check_conditions.answer-support: Authoritative original order, item/change/replacement records and eligible correction/return guidance.
